content:
oncall-bot: Paging: GPU pool 'hotpath-prod' saturated >98% for last 3m, queue length 12.3k, 429 spike 86% in last 2m. Severity: Sev2. @eng-oncall paged.

maria: ack I'm on it.

maria: quick check - are autoscaler logs showing failures?

ops: autoscaler shows repeated scale attempts failing: 'scale limit reached' and cloud error 'GpuQuotaExceeded' for nodegroup hotpath-prod-1. Also high tokenbucket reject rate on prod-tier.

raj: seeing 429s concentrated on /v2/generate and /chat/completions routes. Rate policy 'prod-tier' tokens look misapplied to hotpath requests after rollout.

sre-lead: timeline note: config rollout r-2026-03-15 applied at 10:12 UTC touched ratepolicy mapping for prod-tier -> hotpath.

maria: mitigation plan (initial):
- increase tokenbucket refill and burst for prod-tier
- enable fallback routing to smaller model for low-priority requests
- try to add emergency nodes in alternate AZ
- avoid full rollback unless we see regression

tim: fallback to medium model to clear backlog sounds good. Set non-critical traffic to 'redwood-medium-v1'.

maria: agree. applying config patch now.

```bash
# increase token rate and burst for prod-tier
curl -X PATCH 'https://ops.internal/api/v1/ratepolicy/prod-tier' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_API' \
  -d '{\n    "token_rate": 2500,\n    "burst": 8000,\n    "apply_mode": "immediate"\n  }'
```

deploy-bot: change cp-99876 accepted and applying to prod (immediate).

maria: applied patch, toggled allow-fallback on hotpath router. Watching metrics.

eng-oncall: started reroute - non-critical routes -> redwood-medium-v1. Command: POST /routers/hotpath/reroute {priority: noncritical, model: redwood-medium-v1} (applied).

ops: autoscaler request +4 nodes submitted; cloud returned GpuQuotaExceeded in us-west-2a. Trying us-west-2b. Provision time ~6-12m if quota available.

raj: stepping in to handle tokenbucket tuning and fallback. If that doesn't bring queue down we'll force unlock autoscaler and attempt provisioning in other AZ.

customer-success: CS alerted: three customers show elevated errors (acct A, B, C). Notified A and B, CS rep assigned to A until cleared.

maria: live metrics update: 429 rate dropped from 86% -> 22% within 90s after tokenbucket tweak + fallback. Queue length 12.3k -> 4.1k. P95 latency improving but still elevated for priority traffic.

sre-lead: good. next steps: hold config, monitor for 15-30m, then roll forward or rollback the rollout r-2026-03-15 depending on outcome. We also need a postmortem on rollout gating.

tim: autoscaler still stuck due to 'scale-inhibit' lock/backoff. I'll attempt force-unlock.

```bash
# force unlock autoscaler pool hotpath-prod
kubectl exec -n ops autoscaler-ctl -- /bin/sh -c "autoscaler unlock --pool hotpath-prod"
```

deploy-bot: autoscaler unlock command executed, new scale attempts allowed.

ops: new nodes in us-west-2b reporting ready; added +2 GPU nodes (total +8 GPUs across pool) and queue draining accelerated.

maria: status update: queue now 1.2k and falling, 429 rate steady ~5%. Customer-facing mitigations in place, CS working with impacted accounts.

raj: taking on-call handoff for 2h. I'll keep an eye on tokenbucket reject rate, autoscaler activity, and queue tail. If anything spikes ping me directly.

oncall-bot: Incident status -> downgraded to Sev3 at 3769991410. Summary: root cause: misapplied ratepolicy rollout causing global tokenbucket caps to be too restrictive on hotpath. Secondary: autoscaler couldn't immediately add capacity due to regional GPU quota. Mitigations: increased token rate/burst, enabled fallback routing to smaller model, forced autoscaler unlock and provisioned nodes in alternate AZ, CS notified impacted customers.

maria: filing postmortem now (will link to doc). Action items: add rollout preflight to validate tier mappings, automate fallback for hotpath when queue > X, request quota increase in us-west-2.

raj: thanks team. I'll monitor for 2h and escalate if we see reversion. :thumbsup:

customer-success: leaving note - customers A/B acknowledged updates and support calls in progress.

maria: thanks everyone. closing channel for now, will reopen if metrics regress.
